page.overview:
What is Plasma cell?

Plasma cells were energy storage devices used notably for laser cannon. The CR90 corvette Thunderstrike used plasma cells, and at least one of them was drained into an emergency generator after the corvette was shot down on the planet Sullust in 3 ABY.

Plasma cells appeared in the 2015 novel Battlefront: Twilight Company, written by Alexander Freed.
